FinZoraFAQ1.title: Frequently
FinZoraFAQ1.description: Find quick answers to the most common questions about our loan and financial services.

image.alt: FAQ clipboard with a question mark

items.question: What types of loans do you offer?
items.answer: We offer a range of loan solutions including Personal Loans, Business Loans, Vehicle Loans, Home Loans, and Loan Against Property (LAP) to meet various financial needs.

items.question: What is the eligibility for a loan?
items.answer: Eligibility depends on the loan type, but generally you should be an Indian resident aged 21 to 60 with a stable income source, a good credit history and valid KYC documents.

items.question: How long does it take to get loan approval?
items.answer: Most applications are reviewed within 24 to 48 hours once all documents are submitted. Disbursement follows quickly after approval and verification.

items.question: What documents are required to apply?
items.answer: You will typically need identity and address proof (Aadhaar, PAN), recent bank statements, income proof such as salary slips or ITR, and a passport-size photograph. Business loans may need additional business documents.

items.question: Can I prepay my loan before the tenure ends?
items.answer: Yes, you can prepay or foreclose your loan before the tenure ends. Applicable prepayment charges, if any, will be clearly shared with you in the loan agreement.

items.question: How can I track my loan application?
items.answer: Our support team keeps you updated at every step by call, SMS and email. You can also contact us anytime with your application number for the latest status.
